In 1976, we began our journey under immense challenges. No consultants. No capital. What we had was unwavering determination-and a mission: To make nutrition a right for every Vietnamese child. No consultants, no capital-what we had was unwavering determination to achieve our mission. We overcame skepticism to prove that it’s entirely possible to create high-quality nutritional products for every Vietnamese. We believe the hardest challenges are the ones worth pursuing-because no one else will do.
...

From formulating the first Dielac product tailored to the nutritional needs of Vietnamese children, to building a diverse portfolio of over 200 products serving all age groups, our journey has been defined by purpose-driven growth.
...

Every Vinamilk product is a promise—crafted with care, backed by science, and designed to empower consumers to nurture themselves and their loved ones with confidence.

searchResults.title: Investor Relations | Vinamilk
searchResults.highlight: With a legacy of growth since 1976, Vinamilk has become a national icon of nutrition and Vietnam's leading dairy company, publicly listed since 2006. Vinamilk not only holds the number one position in the domestic market but has also cemented its position on the global stage, ranking 36th among the world's top dairy companies by revenue. With a brand valued at USD 3 billion, our products now have a presence in 65 countries and territories. This global expansion is built upon a network of farms and high-quality raw material sources that adhere to stringent international standards. Leveraging an extensive multi-channel distribution network, Vinamilk provides consumers with a diverse product portfolio catering to all needs, from mainstream to premium segments. Driven by a commitment to continuous innovation, Vinamilk’s vision is to become a world-class food brand and a trusted icon for nutrition and health, dedicated to serving the community.
